purpose: Two independent transparent 2D firebird bodies, hand-authored native mesh deformation and keyframe motion to follow. Not Live2D SDK or Unity runtime implementation.
references: Original combat screenshots inform flame palette and readable bird silhouette; artwork generated rather than traced or extracted.

prompts.flight: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game VFX sprite, a flaming phoenix for the horizontal-flight body of a card-battle spell. Reference role: the two previously viewed original-game screenshots inform only the broad fire-wing silhouette and yellow/orange/red layering; create original artwork, do not trace a screenshot. One complete phoenix, flying fast toward screen LEFT, three-quarter SIDE view, small distinct hooked beak and stretched neck pointing left, compact luminous chest, two enormous swept wings clearly attached to the shoulders, near wing rises and far wing sweeps lower in the projection, long narrow tail flames streaming to screen RIGHT. Bird is MADE OF FIRE: broad continuous golden-yellow flame masses form the leading wings, only 5–7 separated elongated flame tongues per wing, torn red-orange trailing edges, bright pale-yellow center, tiny amount of near-white heat, airy transparent gaps. Readable strong simple silhouette at small battle scale. Painterly hand-drawn 2D action-RPG effects, sharp flame shapes with soft translucent outer glow; smooth broad shapes rather than uniform feathers or noisy fractal spaghetti. Fully isolated on TRUE TRANSPARENT background with generous empty margins all around the entire wings and tail. Wide landscape composition, no crop. No real feather texture, no solid animal skin, no outline cartoon mascot, no emblem, no UI, no text, no frame, no scenery, no card, no shadow platform, no black backing and no opaque rectangle. Neutral mid-flap pose suitable for subsequent layered mesh animation; do not draw speed lines across the empty canvas.
prompts.flightFraming: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached transparent flaming phoenix sprite. Keep its facing-left pose, silhouette, attached wings, fire colors and hand-painted appearance. Correct the framing: the ENTIRE phoenix and all flame tips and tail must fit inside the image with an even clear transparent margin of at least 12 percent on every side. Scale the whole existing subject down and recenter it, complete any clipped tip naturally. Transparent background must remain genuinely transparent, with soft alpha on flame glow and no black/white fill. Do not add objects, text, frames, shadows, scenery or additional birds. Output is one complete wide landscape game sprite suitable for mesh animation.
prompts.dive: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a COMPANION TRANSPARENT GAME VFX SPRITE in the same painted flame colors and visual style as the referenced side-flight phoenix, but a completely different pose for a straight downward DIVE. This is a separate full body, not a rotated side sprite. One flaming phoenix seen FRONTALLY from a slightly elevated view, flying toward the BOTTOM of the image. Head at the lower center, visibly hooked beak pointing DOWN toward impact, streamlined chest extending upward behind the neck, two broad wings spread symmetrically LEFT and RIGHT and swept UPWARD, showing distinct shoulders and 5–7 long separated flame tongues each. A few narrow tail flames stream toward the TOP. Strong wide V silhouette, anatomically connected, head and chest visible and not hidden by the wings. Broad smooth golden-yellow flame masses on leading wing edges, bright pale-yellow core, orange-red broken trailing edges and soft alpha glow. Entire bird is made of flame, no real feather texture or solid animal skin. Readable at card-battle scale, not detailed noisy fire spaghetti. Transparent negative spaces between tongues. Fit ALL wings/tail/head within a generous clear transparent margin of 12 percent all around; wide landscape canvas. No scenery, UI, text, border, shadow, disk, halo, background smoke rectangle, black or white backing, no second bird. Reference image is for matching fire palette/material only; DO NOT retain its sideways facing-left pose. New independent diving body suitable for subsequent wing-fold and flame-ripple mesh keyframes.
